props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on cancel, on Escape, and on a backdrop click.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when the confirming action is pressed.

props.name: title
props.description: The question, put as a statement. Becomes the accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: What is about to happen, and to what. Name the consequence, not the mechanism.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Label for the confirming action. Name the verb rather than saying OK.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Colours the confirming action as dangerous.

props.name: busy
props.description: Shows a spinner in the confirming action and blocks it.

props.name: confirmationText
props.description: Require the user to type this exactly before confirming.
